prompts: Use case: compositing. Edit target: the supplied accessories campaign photograph. Create a wide 3:1 landscape panoramic adaptation for a shallow luxury website section. Keep the same exact tan structured leather tote, brown penny loafers pair, silver analog watch with brown leather strap and black rectangular sunglasses; preserve their colors, shapes and material detail. Arrange all four product types together across the right 60 percent of the frame on restrained low grey stone plinths, with complete handles, both shoes, watch and sunglasses visible. The entire merchandise group must fit within the central 55 percent of image HEIGHT, leaving generous clear background above and below so a shallow desktop section can frame the scene without cropping any product. Leave the left 35 percent as quiet softly shaded charcoal-grey studio space for page text. Use one continuous textured cool grey studio backdrop with smooth natural light variation and soft realistic shadows; no sharp vertical partition, wall-panel edge, split composition, dark rectangle, or visible backdrop seam. High quality realistic product photography matching the supplied reference. Keep products well separated and clearly inspectable; no people, clothing, extra products, logos, brand marks, text, UI or watermarks. Output a wide image approximately 2400x800.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied wide accessories photograph. This is a precise framing correction for a shallow homepage strip. Keep the same four products, same colors, grey stone plinths, continuous textured grey studio, realistic lighting and wide 3:1 composition. Make the ENTIRE merchandise group (tote including full handles, two loafers, watch, sunglasses and plinths) approximately HALF its present vertical size. Place that smaller group on the RIGHT HALF, vertically CENTERED in the image. The highest point of the tote handle MUST be below 28 percent of image height; the lowest product/plinth must be above 75 percent of image height. Keep all products grouped but distinct and recognizable. There must be generous plain studio background in the top quarter and bottom quarter and left 40 percent so the photograph can be framed in a shallow horizontal band without clipping merchandise. Do not crop, move items to the left copy area, add products, add text, add logos or add a vertical seam. Retain faithful full product silhouettes and materials. This is a naturally photographed wider, more distant camera framing, not a collage.
